requirements.statement: Refuse a new run when free space on the workspace root is below the larger of 2 GiB and 5%; equal and above allow.
Apply the same rule to the state folder separately from the workspace root.
The needed free space is the larger of the byte limit and the percentage of the disk, exact at the switch-over.
A refused run gives a plain reason naming the folder, free and needed amounts and how to change the limit, before any account or run write, and is never reported as started.
Limits come from the shared user-settings file; overrides work and out-of-range values are refused with a visible warning.
Memory pressure is reported only and never refuses a run.
A failing disk probe fails safe: new runs are refused with a plain reason.
Low or unreadable disks are reported to the user as plain health findings; no import-time I/O.
